cue_start_first: Start cooking or plant a crop first. There is nothing new to wait for yet.
cue_watching: You'll hear one alert when this meal or crop is ready. Pausing, a fault or loading a save cancels the alert.
cue_completed: Ready. Collect your meal or harvest the crop. Set another alert for the next batch.
loot_enabled_setting: Allow Agriculture supplies in newly stocked fridges and crates, and loose machinery among engineering finds. Existing contents and shops are unchanged. Restart after changing.
loot_multiplier_setting: Chance of Agriculture finds (0 off; 1 normal; maximum 3). Each place that can stock them gets at most one extra item. Shops are unchanged. Restart after changing.
rack_desc: Firstlight-4: fresh food starts here. A 4 x 4 growing rack holding 20 kg of liquid and 0.5 kg of nutrients, dry or dissolved. Load supplies through Inventory, or connect a W2 with the right feed for your crop. Growth times and feed mixes are simplified for play.
cooker_desc: Hearth-2: a hot meal between shifts. This 2 x 2 cooker draws 2 kW: 90 seconds for a 0.4 kg potato portion, ten minutes to bake 0.4 kg of wheat grain and a water ration into flatbread. The cabin gets the spare heat.
potato_seed_desc: Continuance planting stock from Verdemorrow Agronomics. Save viable tubers from the harvest for your next planting. These are for the rack, not the dinner tray.
lettuce_seed_desc: Continuance seeds from Verdemorrow Agronomics. Enough for one planting. Grow lettuce for seed to replace them; a leaf harvest won't restock the packet.
wheat_seed_desc: Continuance seed wheat from Verdemorrow Agronomics: a dwarf variety bred to stay short under rack lights. One packet sows one rack, and each harvest gives a packet back.
nutrients_desc: Groundwork plant feed from Verdemorrow Agronomics. The rack's pantry in a packet. Use the proper feed: raw ore and wastewater won't do. The nutrient mix is simplified for play.
raw_desc: A galley's worth of promise. Cook this portion in the Hearth-2 before eating.
meal_desc: Hot potatoes from the galley. A proper meal after a shift in the boneyard.
leaves_desc: Fresh leaves grown aboard ship. A light bite and a welcome change from packaged meals.
wheat_grain_desc: Dry grain from the rack. It keeps for as long as you need it to. Bake it in the Hearth-2 with a water ration; chewing it raw is for the desperate.
flatbread_desc: A round of hot flatbread from the galley. Filling enough to carry a shift, and it smells like somewhere with weather.
residue_desc: Older crop waste with no record of its nutrients. B2 cannot recover feed from it. Mass varies.
drainage_desc: Older growing water with no nutrient record. Cannot be treated. Do not drink.
missing_package: Enable the Phobos Agriculture content package that matches this plugin.
protected: Stopped to protect saved contents or settings that could not be checked safely. See the log for details.
fault: Stopped after a fault. Contents have been kept. Check the log for details.
gap: Stopped after a gap in readings. No growth was added for that time. Resume when ready.
access: An awake crew member must stand beside unlocked equipment on this ship. Remote use needs a powered console you can access.
local_work: Send a crew member to work beside the machine.
queued: Work queued for crew. Supplies and space for the results will be checked again before completion.
repair: Install and repair the equipment first.

pace_setting: Growth duration, set when planted: 0.5-2x normal time. Faster crops still need the full cycle's energy.
reserve_setting: Drinking water to leave for the crew in this ship's usable tanks, in litres. Default 10; adjust for crew size.
missing_input: Put one suitable supply item in the machine's Inventory. Split it from its stack first.
done: Done. Supplies used and results delivered.
not_ready: Crop is not ready to harvest.
full: No room for the results. Contents have been kept.
rack_full: {0}: its rack is full. Take something out of its inventory, then try again.
panel_help: Put supplies in Inventory and collect results there. Crew do the planting, loading and harvesting. Pausing the controls doesn't stop plants breathing.
build_desc: Assemble an empty appliance, ready to install.
unload_first: Remove the crop and empty all contents before uninstalling or dismantling.
cancel_missing: The potato portion for this batch is missing. Return it or cancel the batch before starting another.
no_provider: No compatible Ship's Water supply. Load irrigation charges or water rations by hand.
cooker_supply_missing: The cooking is done except for its supply: bread needs a water ration in the cooker. Add one and choose Start to finish it.
crop_dead: Crop lost. Clear the dead plants to plant again.
crop_stress: Poor growing conditions for {0:0.0} h; check cabin, power and supplies.
carbon_low: Not enough CO2 in the cabin for the plants.
power_low: Not enough power for the growing rack.
irrigation_desc: Groundwork water for thirsty roots. Needs 5 kg of free tank space. Not drinking water; cannot be decanted into drinking supplies. The listed mass counts water only.
irrigation_full: Make {0} kg of room in the tank first. The water charge is still here.
water_supply_desc: Groundwork W2: mix feed and water up to eight linked racks. This 2 x 2 unit weighs 20 kg empty and holds 20 kg of liquid plus 0.5 kg of nutrients. The racks share one 0.18 kW pump. Load nutrient packets or B2 mixtures in Inventory for gradual mixing. A cartridge adds 0.5 kW drainage treatment. Load water by hand or use compatible Ship's Water tanks. Pipe flow and travel time are simplified for play.
water_pipe_desc: A 1 kg irrigation pipe covering one tile. Connects north, south, east and west; crossings join. The W2 fills it first, about 0.2 kg of water or feed a tile, and it keeps what it holds: drain it into a canister before taking it up. Flow is simplified for play.
water_pause: Pause both machines and their water intake first. Both must be working, unlocked and on your ship, with no saved-settings fault.
water_missing: The selected water connection is unavailable.
water_no_conduit: No water conduit joins the W2's outlet to this rack's inlet. Lay conduit between them first; racks link only along a conduit, never across open floor.
water_pair_help: Pause both machines before linking. One W2 can supply eight racks; each rack accepts one supplier. Enable intake separately at each rack. Disconnecting a rack removes its own link; disconnecting W2 removes all its links. Drain pipes first. Use one supply unit per pipe circuit.
water_no_route: No working pipe connection. Check the links, pipes, supporting floors and inlet/outlet positions. Use one supply unit per pipe circuit.
mix-potato: Select potato feed (pause and unlink first)
mix-lettuce: Select lettuce feed (pause and unlink first)
mix-wheat: Select wheat feed (pause and unlink first)
water-only: Select water only (pause and unlink first)
solution_switch: Pause work and water intake, unlink the supply and drain the remaining feed before changing the mix. Drain the rack's feed before switching to direct refill or plain water.
solution_headroom: Leave at least 0.5 kg of room for liquid before selecting plant feed. Drain the tank if needed, then load smaller water charges.
solution_incompatible: This feed is wrong for the crop. Drain it before planting or linking a different feed supply.
solution_receipt: Last feed delivered: {0:0.000000} kg water + {1:0.000000} kg nutrients.
solution_status:
Feed: {0}
Mixed feed: {1:0.000000} kg water + {2:0.000000} kg nutrients
Dry nutrients: {3:0.000000} kg
Total liquid: {4:0.000000} / {5} kg
Feed chemistry is simplified for play; pH and conductivity are not simulated.
line_drain: This rack still holds feed that was in its pipes before the update. Start the W2 so it arrives, or drain the rack, before changing this route or connection.
line_flow: Estimated maximum flow: {0:0.0}% through {1} pipe tiles. Calculated outlet pressure: {2:0.0} kPa at rated pump pressure. Not a sensor reading.
recover-solution: Queue drainage treatment (15 minutes; then Start)
recovery_input: Put Recorded Process Solution and a cartridge with enough capacity in W2 Inventory. Each batch must fit one cartridge. Older saved jobs need their original unused cartridge. Return the batch's supplies or cancel treatment.
recovery_ready: Treatment queued. Start W2 when ready. It uses power and stops water distribution while treating the batch.
recovery_capacity: Treatment ready, but the recovered water and nutrients won't fit. Make room in the tank, then press Start.
recovery_progress: Treatment electricity used: {0:0.0}% of the batch's needs.
characterized_drainage_desc: Used growing water with its nutrient content recorded. W2 can recover some of it with a treatment cartridge and power. Older unrecorded waste cannot be used. Do not drink.
recovery_cartridge_desc: Give used growing water another shift. A new cartridge contains 0.05 kg of treatment medium for 25 kg of recorded drainage. Uses 0.002 kg per kg treated; keep the partly used cartridge for later. This simplified process does not make drinking water.
recovery_reject_desc: Used filter material with water and nutrients the treatment couldn't recover. Cannot be treated again. Not food or drinking water.
recovery_status: Treating batch {0}; power used: {1:0.0000} kWh. Return its supplies, or pause and Cancel treatment.
mix-lettuce-seed: Select feed for lettuce seeds (pause first)
solution_lettuce-seed-v1: Feed for lettuce grown for seed
recovery_capacity_status: Cartridge can treat {0:0.000} kg more drainage. A whole batch must fit one cartridge. Keep the remaining capacity for later; treatment rates are set for play.
recovery_legacy: Older saved job: uses one whole unused cartridge per batch.
workup_bench_desc: Groundwork B2: put crop waste back to work. This enclosed 2 x 2 bench recovers concentrate from recorded crop residue, then mixes it with an equal mass of Groundwork makeup salts. Uses 0.5 kW and leaves spent plant matter. Nutrient recovery is simplified for play.
recorded_residue_desc: Fresh crop waste with a record of the nutrients used to grow it. Feed it to B2 for recovery. Older unrecorded waste and already-processed plant matter cannot be used.
concentrate_desc: Recovered nutrients that aren't yet a complete feed. Mix with an equal mass of makeup salts at B2 before using in W2. Mass varies. Do not drink.
spent_biomass_desc: Wet plant matter left after B2 has recovered what it can. Nothing more to extract here. Mass varies.
makeup_desc: The missing half of B2's recovered feed. Mix with an equal mass of recorded concentrate. Keep partly used packets; Repair and Restore cannot refill them.
mixture_desc: Plant feed mixed at B2. Put it in W2 Inventory, pause, select the charge and crop mix, then Start. Used only while the mixer has power; the panel shows what's left. Repair and Restore cannot refill it.
workup_queued: Supplies set aside. Start when ready and leave room for all results. Loading a save pauses the job.
workup_input: Load recorded crop residue, or recorded concentrate with enough makeup salts. Keep the supplies in this bench until the job finishes.
dose_empty: No usable nutrient charge selected. Pause and select one from Inventory. Dry nutrients already loaded can still be used.
dose_status: Feeding from {0}: {1:0.000} g left ({2:0.0}%). Used only during mixing. Repair and Restore cannot refill it.
consumable_no_repair: Repair and Restore cannot refill used supplies.
wet_rejects_desc: Wet waste from Valtora's Ship's Water 0.16.1 Recycler. Not fertilizer: B2 cannot process it. Holds up to 13 kg per packet. Water uses a simplified 1 kg/L conversion.
capture_unavailable: Needs Valtora's Ship's Water 0.16.1 Recycler and a compatible Phobos Shipbreaker collector.
capture_access: Stand beside both machines. They must be working and unlocked on this ship. Put the collector's two-tile pocket against the Recycler, service side facing away. Floor mounts need two structural floor tiles and a clear two-tile service walkway. Hull mounts still need their usual supports.
capture-unlink: Detach collector and restore ordinary recycling
capture_enabled: Collection on. Waiting for a working powered collector with room for the wet waste.
capture_paused: Collection paused. Enable it again after loading a save.
dose-inventory: Use first nutrient charge in Inventory
crew_recipe_cook: Cook what the galley has: potatoes, or grain into bread
crew_select_recipe: Choose what to grow or make here.
crew_supplies: Need approved supplies or more storage space. Seed stock and the crew's drinking-water reserve stay protected.
panel_live: Progress {0:0}% · Health {1:0}% · Water {2:0.00} kg · Nutrients {3:0.000} kg
panel_supply: Plain water {0:0.00} kg · Nutrient solution {1:0.00} kg
bulk_nutrients_desc: 500 g of dry plant feed for W2. Select it in Inventory for gradual mixing. Mass and value fall as it is used. Contains no water and cannot be refilled by repair. To have crew replace it, enable the replacement standing order.
bulk-drain: Drain up to 20 kg for treatment (some is lost)
bulk_pair: Place an intact water silo within one tile of the W2 (touching or one tile apart, diagonals count), or lay a process-water line so it runs under or right beside both.
bulk_quote_changed: The destination or room in it changed. Choose the quantity again for a fresh quote.
bulk_catch_wait: Repair the tank and recover the trapped water beside it before filling.
crew_recipe_bulk-fill: Keep the silo stocked with irrigation charges
crew_recipe_supply-charges: Distribute feed and replace selected charges
bulk_intake_wait: Waiting. Check the silo's water and reserve, damage, the connection, service access and room in the W2. This connection draws from the linked silo only.
bulk_intake_ready: Ready when intake is enabled. Shares W2's pump power.
shipswater_unreached: No Ship's Water tank touches this machine or shares its water line, so it draws no drinking water. Place a tank within a tile of it, or lay process-water line so it runs under or right beside both.
Maintenance.ready: Ready for removal. You still need crew access, tools and materials for the job.
Maintenance.protected: A saved transfer or process needs attention. Keep the equipment in place and inspect its control panel before maintenance.
Maintenance.tank: Drain the tank before removing or dismantling it.
Maintenance.link: Unlink the empty tank from its equipment before removal.
Maintenance.contents: Remove crops, food, nutrients and all remaining water or feed before moving this equipment. Check its supply and pipe contents in the Control Panel.
Maintenance.job: Finish or cancel the cooking or workup job before removing this equipment.
accept_done: Contents accepted. The machine's weight now matches its saved contents and it can be used again.
accept_unavailable: Cannot accept these contents. Their saved record cannot be read, or the equipment needs repair first.
crop_present: A crop is already planted. Harvest or clear it first.
bulk_tank_details: {0:F0} kg of water for the next growing shift. This {1} x {1} tank weighs {2:F0} kg empty and needs no power. A W2 within one tile pumps from it. Damage traps water in a catch tank: repair, then recover it. Drain before moving or dismantling. Not for drinking water.
bulk_tank_desc: A Groundwork water reservoir keeps process water by the kilogram for the growing shift. A W2 within one tile draws from it; link it on the W2's Supplies page. Not for drinking.
vessels_commodity: {0} holds {1}; the vessels file cannot change what it holds.
materials_bound: {0} must stay {1} kg at {2} cr: the crop, recovery and workup models are written for it.
crops_empty: The crops file lists no crops.
crops_id: Crop name {0} is not usable: use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
crops_positive: Crop {0} has a figure that is missing, negative or zero where it cannot be.
crops_limits: Crop {0} is outside what a rack can do: at most {1:F0} hours and {2:F1} kW.
crops_name: Crop {0}: a plain name is at most 40 ordinary characters.
crops_carbon: Crop {0} holds more carbon than it weighs, or its seed weighs as much as its harvest.
crops_mass: Crop {0} does not conserve mass: it takes in {1:F4} kg and grows by {2:F4} kg. Water plus nutrient plus 0.4 x carbon, less vapour, must equal final less seed.
crops_rack: Crop {0} needs more than a rack holds: at most {1:F0} kg of water and {2:F1} kg of nutrient.
crops_harvest: Crop {0} gives more than it grows: the edible share, the kept stock and one portion must fit inside the harvest.
crops_item: Crop {0} names an item this mod does not have: {1}.
crops_unit: Crop {0}: one {1} must weigh {2:R} kg, and the materials file says {3:R} kg.
crops_kept: Crop {0}: stock kept back at harvest must be exactly one planting.
crops_feed: Crop {0} needs its own feed name and its own conduit name: {1} is missing or already used.
crops_art: Crop {0} needs the artwork name of a crop that ships with the mod, such as Potato or Lettuce.
crops_item_entry: Crop item {0} is not one of this mod's items, or its name and description text are missing.
crops_food: Crop item {0}: hunger and satiety go together, each from 1 to 20.
crops_frozen_missing: Published crop {0} is missing. A published crop can never be removed; saved plantings depend on it.
crops_frozen_changed: The file changes published crop {0}. Add a new crop beside it instead; saved plantings keep the old one.
hearth_recipe_shape: Cooking recipe {0} must take one portion and at most one supply, one unit of each, give at least one item, and say how many seconds it cooks.
hearth_recipe_item: Cooking recipe {0} names an item this mod does not have.
hearth_recipe_input: Cooking recipe {0}: another recipe already cooks {1}.
hopper_details: Holds {0:F0} kg of dry plant feed. This {1} x {1} hopper weighs {2:F0} kg empty and needs no power. Fill it at a station's refuelling kiosk under Bulk supplies. Choose it as the nutrient source for a W2 within one tile; the W2 draws feed while mixing. Damage traps feed in a catch chamber: repair, then recover it. Bag the feed before moving or dismantling the hopper.
hopper_desc: A Groundwork hopper keeps dry plant feed ready by the kilogram. A W2 within one tile draws from it as it mixes; choose the hopper on the W2's Supplies page.
hopper_status:
Nutrients ready: {0:F2} kg | Trapped: {1:F2} kg
Capacity: {2:F0} kg
hopper_catch_wait: Repair the hopper, then recover the trapped nutrients before it can dose or be filled.
hopper-bag: Bag up to 500 g as a bulk nutrient charge
dose_hopper_status: Feeding from {0}: {1:F2} kg of nutrients ready. Used only during mixing.
dose_hopper_unready: Cannot draw nutrients from {0} ({1:F2} kg ready). Check for damage, a saved-contents fault, trapped nutrients, an empty hopper or a broken connection.
Maintenance.hopper: Bag the hopper's nutrients before moving or dismantling it.
line_legacy: Feed from before the update still on its way into this rack: {0:0.000} kg. The W2 delivers it on its next powered run.
line_priming: Filling the pipes before feed reaches the rack: {0:0.00} of {1:0.00} kg over {2} pipe tiles.
line_flushing: Flushing the old feed out of the pipes first: {0:0.00} kg back to the W2 this step, as water in its reservoir or as process solution in its inventory for treatment.
line_flush_full: The pipes still hold the old feed, and the W2 has no room in its inventory for the flushed process solution. Clear a space so the flush can finish.
